name: Starry Wisp
description: Evocation cantrip, Druid access only here. Action, 60 feet, V/S, instantaneous. Ranged spell attack against one creature or object, hit 1d8 Radiant, increasing to 2d8/3d8/4d8 at levels 5/11/17. On hit target sheds Dim Light ten feet and cannot benefit from Invisible until the end of your next turn. No save, slot or counter.
